facts.claim: 37% of B2B software companies now run a hybrid pricing model, up from 25% twelve months earlier
facts.source_title: The 2026 State of B2B SaaS and AI Monetization Report
facts.excerpt: About two-in-five participants (37%) said they have a hybrid pricing model, up from 25% twelve months ago.

facts.claim: Chargebee reports 43% of companies using hybrid pricing models, projected to reach 61% by the end of 2026
facts.source_title: The 2026 Guide to SaaS, AI and Agentic Pricing Models
facts.excerpt: Chargebee's State of Subscriptions Report: 43% of companies now use hybrid models, with adoption projected to reach 61% by end of 2026.

facts.claim: Seat-based contracts still account for 65% to 75% of software spend while consumption-based pricing sits at 4% to 6%
facts.source_title: From seats to consumption: why SaaS pricing has entered its hybrid era
facts.excerpt: Seat-based contracts account for 65-75% of spend, and consumption-based pricing is stuck at 4-6%.

facts.claim: Asked which pricing model investors prefer, 35% named hybrid, 26% outcome-based and 24% usage-based, against 10% flat-fee and 5% seat-based
facts.source_title: The 2026 State of B2B SaaS and AI Monetization Report
facts.excerpt: Asked which pricing model investors prefer: usage-based 24%, outcome-based 26%, hybrid 35%, flat-fee 10%, seat-based 5%.

facts.claim: Gross revenue retention by contract size runs 82% under 25,000 dollars ACV, 88% from 25,000 to 100,000, and 95% above
facts.excerpt: SMB (<$25K ACV): 82% GRR; Mid-Market ($25K-$100K): 88% GRR; Enterprise (>$100K ACV): 95% GRR.

facts.claim: Median gross margin for private SaaS between 5 million and 50 million dollars ARR is 71% to 74%
facts.excerpt: The median gross margin for private SaaS companies with $5M-$50M ARR is 71-74% in 2026.
